stem.text: The diagram shows part of the cell surface membrane of an active animal cell.

stem.alt: Diagram of a cell surface membrane with molecules labelled L and M, and X and Y marked above and below the membrane with water potential labels.

stem.text: Which statements correctly describe the net movement of molecules across this membrane?

items: Oxygen diffuses through molecules M from X to Y.
Carbon dioxide diffuses through molecules M from X to Y.
Water moves from Y to X through molecule L.
